text: Seabrook Town increases pressure on the right flank, pushing inside Harbour City’s half near the corner of the penalty area at the far end. They make several final third entries with wide crosses aimed towards their forwards positioned centrally and near the left side of the six-yard box. Kian Romano attempts a header just outside the six-yard box and later a shot with his foot from distance, both narrowly missing the goal. Seabrook Town’s tactics focus on creating chances through wide play and crossing as they seek to break the 2-2 deadlock in this late stage of the match. [#1744] [#1850]
